    toc-expand: 4

Learning objectives for this week:

- Understand basic machine learning learning terminology such as target/feature, supervised/unsupervised and classification/regression.
- Understand the k-nearest neighbors algorithm and its applications.
- Perform train-test splits for training models.
- Understand confusion matrices for classification models.
- Implement one-hot encoding  to transform categorical variables into a format suitable for machine learning models.
- Implement feature scaling techniques to transform the features into a normalized range.
- Construct machine learning pipelines to streamline data preprocessing.
